title: The Last Garden Anew
author: Freya Amberdale
blurb: Noor Iversen, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
